steps.en: Clone the repo and run the guided installer; keep one LLM API key at hand
steps.zh: 克隆仓库跑引导式安装器，手边备一个模型 API Key

steps.en: Checks Python, Node and FFmpeg, creates an isolated easel profile on OpenClaw, builds the web workbench
steps.zh: 检查依赖，建隔离 easel profile 和 Web 工作台

steps.en: Start the workbench, fill the account profile, log in your platforms in the Accounts page
steps.zh: 启动工作台，填画像，登录各平台

steps.en: Boots the gateway; serves chat, the 113-skill library, trend radar, calendar and publishing center
steps.zh: 拉起网关，提供对话、技能库、热点雷达、日历和发布中心

steps.en: Brief the agent in chat: this week's topics for this account, then a Xiaohongshu card and a short video
steps.zh: 在对话里下需求：本周适合本账号的选题，出小红书卡片和短视频

steps.en: Picks skills, runs real scripts (TTS, transcription, ffmpeg), archives deliverables to outputs/
steps.zh: 选技能、跑真脚本（配音、转写、ffmpeg），成品归档到 outputs/

steps.en: Preview each platform version, pass the preflight checks, confirm publishing (Xiaohongshu: confirm manually)
steps.zh: 预览各平台版本，过发布前检查，确认发布（小红书手动确认）

steps.en: Publishes through logged-in accounts and reads performance back into the profile
steps.zh: 走已登录账号发布，把数据表现读回画像

value.en: Trend hunting, drafting, rendering, per-platform reformatting and manual cross-posting disappear; each cycle's numbers sharpen the next
value.zh: 找热点、写初稿、渲染成品、按平台改格式、逐平台手动发布都省掉；每一轮数据让下一轮更贴账号

sources: https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/Easel README 快速开始 (git clone + bash setup.sh; guided installer checks Python/Node/Git/FFmpeg, creates the isolated easel OpenClaw profile, builds the web workbench and installs Chromium; prompts for the model key)
README 使用 Easel (easel web starts the workbench on 7860; easel chat/skill/doctor/ping; all skills run through the agent, which reads SKILL.md and archives deliverables to outputs/)

README 账号画像 (cp -r profiles/_template "profiles/我的账号"; six dimensions per profile) and 已经落地的能力 (seven-platform publishing: Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Zhihu, Bilibili, WeChat Channels, WeChat Official Account)
README 使用提示 (Xiaohongshu automation risk — prefer preview and human-confirmed publishing) and CHANGELOG v0.2.1 (publishing read-back, preflight checks)
